description: This file defines the SshFtpClient class, which implements an FTP client over SSH using the SSHD library. It provides methods to connect, copy files, list directory contents, and close the connection.

classes.name: SshFtpClient
classes.description: A client class for transferring files over SSH using SFTP, implementing the FtpClientInterface.

methods.name: SshFtpClient
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SSH client.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes an SSH connection and initializes SFTP session.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies a file from an InputStream to the remote server at the specified path and filename.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists files in the specified directory on the remote server.

methods.name: setBinaryTransfer
methods.description: Stub method for setting binary transfer mode (not implemented).

methods.name: setPassiveMode
methods.description: Stub method for setting passive mode (not implemented).

methods.name: closeConnection
methods.description: Closes the SFTP and SSH sessions.
